rows.quote: We found 38 PD-related proteins, with six of the top ten validated in the Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative (PPMI) cohort.
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the PPMI cohort as the validation dataset; the dictionary has no outcome row for PPMI.

rows.quote: We analyzed 2,920 Olink-measured plasma proteins in 51,804 UK Biobank participants, identifying 859 incident PD cases after 14.45 years.
rows.coder_note: Rule C: the authors' own analysis of UK Biobank individual-level data, defined by analytic sample (51,804), phenotype (859 incident PD cases) and follow-up; no dictionary row is such an analysis and none of the candidate releases is named.
